components.name: Canonical App Mark
components.description: Provider-neutral home mark using the exact canonical SVG geometry.
components.html: <button class="ds-app-mark" type="button" aria-label="Utu home"><svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><rect width="64" height="64" rx="16" fill="#183a31"></rect><path d="M18 19h28v8H18zm0 14h18v12H18zm24 0h4v12h-4z" fill="#eff6f2"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-app-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: block; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-app-mark svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-app-mark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action for the owner's next intentional command.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6"></path></svg>Approve</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--green); color: white; font: 690 11px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--native-control-pressed); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action for local controls and alternatives.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M8 5v14m8-14v14"></path></svg>Pause</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--native-control); color: var(--ink-soft); font: 690 11px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); background: var(--native-control-hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--native-control-pressed); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Utility Rail Navigation
components.description: Stable icon-and-shape app navigation with an explicit active state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-utility-nav" aria-label="Application"><button class="ds-rail-button ds-is-active" type="button" aria-label="Workspace"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 10.5 12 3l9 7.5v9a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5h-15A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 3 19.5zm6 10v-6h6v6"></path></svg></button><button class="ds-rail-button" type="button" aria-label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35m2.35-5.65a8 8 0 1 1-16 0 8 8 0 0 1 16 0"></path></svg></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-utility-nav { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 8px; background: var(--rail-field); border-right: 1px solid var(--line-strong); } .ds-rail-button { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-rail-button:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 72%); color: var(--ink); } .ds-rail-button.ds-is-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--selection) 82%, white); color: var(--green-strong); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(31 122 90 / 10%); } .ds-rail-button:active { background: var(--native-control-pressed); } .ds-rail-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace View Switch
components.description: Compact labeled switch for Attention, Projects, and Fleet within one shell.
components.css: .ds-view-switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--segmented-field); } .ds-view-switch button { min-width: 72px; height: 28px; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 720 9.5px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-view-switch button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 44%); } .ds-view-switch button.ds-is-active { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-raised); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(33 56 47 / 12%); } .ds-view-switch button:active { background: var(--native-control-pressed); } .ds-view-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Evidence Tags
components.description: Text-bearing evidence states that keep observed, inferred, and stale distinct.
components.css: .ds-evidence-set { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-evidence { min-height: 19px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 8.5px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-observed { color: var(--green-strong); background: var(--green-soft); } .ds-inferred { color: #315e7d; background: var(--blue-soft); } .ds-stale { color: #7a510f; background: var(--amber-soft); } .ds-evidence:hover { filter: saturate(1.08); } .ds-evidence:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-evidence:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Context Row
components.description: Signature compact row combining identity, project context, freshness, and selection.
components.css: .ds-context-row { width: 250px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 7px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--selection); color: var(--ink-soft); text-align: left; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 35%, transparent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-avatar { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: #f0b4a8; color: #25312d; font: 760 8px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(24 34 31 / 9%); } .ds-row-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-row-copy strong { overflow: hidden; font: 700 11.5px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font: 400 9.5px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-time { align-self: flex-start; padding-top: 2px; color: var(--quiet); font: 400 9px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-context-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--selection) 82%, white); } .ds-context-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-context-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Direction Composer
components.description: Locally elevated command field with project and agent context attached.
components.css: .ds-composer { width: 420px; padding: 9px 10px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgb(24 46 37 / 5%); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 65%, white); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--green-soft) 70%, transparent); } .ds-composer-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-composer textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 26px; max-height: 90px; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 11.5px/1.52 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--quiet); } .ds-composer-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-top: 5px; } .ds-composer-context { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-composer-context button { height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-soft); color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 9.5px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-context button:hover { background: var(--selection); } .ds-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--green); color: white; cursor: pointer; } .ds-send svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-send:hover { background: var(--green-strong); } .ds-send:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-send:focus-visible, .ds-composer-context button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Toast
components.description: Highest transient feedback layer for truthful command status.
components.html: Direction staged. A live connector will deliver it after explicit confirmation.
components.css: .ds-toast { max-width: 430px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 11px 12px 11px 14px; border-radius: 11px; background: #1e2a26; color: white; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgb(14 29 23 / 24%); font: 400 10.5px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-toast button { padding: 5px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%); color: white; font: 400 9.5px/1 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast button:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 18%); } .ds-toast button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-toast button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid white; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Owner's Workbench is a focused native workspace: light, calm, compact, direct, and operationally truthful. It feels app-native without borrowing a provider's identity, and it lets the owner move quickly among attention, projects, agents, sessions, and evidence without turning the work into a management report.

The system is restrained, precise, and locally tactile. One edge-to-edge work surface holds the task at hand; a stable utility rail and contextual rail establish place, while inspectors and toasts appear only when the owner needs more depth. The titlebar, rails, toolbar, and content read as one continuous desktop window rather than a web page mounted inside a decorative frame. Hierarchy, evidence language, and small responsive state changes create character without a control-room skin or decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Compact native-workspace density with a clear 9–19px type hierarchy.
Provider-neutral identity anchored by the canonical geometric app mark.
Pale mineral surfaces, deep spruce ink, and scarce semantic color.
Edge-to-edge structural panes with transient contextual depth.
Evidence-aware states that pair color with text or shape.
Restrained motion, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion parity.

rules.name: The Scarce Green Rule
rules.body: Use green only for primary action, selected context, and evidence-backed healthy or live state; its rarity preserves operational signal.

rules.name: The Truth Is Redundant Rule
rules.body: Every status pairs color with text or shape, and observed, inferred, stale, unsupported, and failed states remain distinct.

rules.name: The Density Without Squinting Rule
rules.body: Use small type to support fast scanning, never to erase hierarchy or contrast; operational body copy remains readable and secondary copy still meets WCAG AA.

rules.name: The One Window Rule
rules.body: Compose Utu edge to edge as one installed window. Rails, work surface, and standing inspector meet on structural dividers; do not float a rounded website shell over a page-like background.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Standing panes have no elevation. Reserve shadows for the active composer, overlay inspector, and toast.

rules.name: The Local Radius Rule
rules.body: Round interactive objects, never the standing window composition. Use the documented purpose-specific radius rather than an arbitrary new value.

rules.name: The Local Tactility Rule
rules.body: Controls respond where the owner is acting through restrained tonal change, border emphasis, and visible focus rather than decorative motion.

dos: **Do** keep Attention, Projects, and Fleet inside the same stable shell and preserve selection and command context when switching.
**Do** label demo, read-only, observed, inferred, stale, unsupported, failed, and partial-evidence states honestly.
**Do** use the canonical app mark and code-native SVG icons; keep provider identity in text rather than brand logos.
**Do** keep Quiet Gray and Evidence Amber above 4.5:1 on every relevant surface, preserve visible keyboard focus, and respect reduced motion.
**Do** preserve text or shape alongside every semantic color.
donts: **Don't** compose the home experience as a SaaS admin dashboard, KPI strip, analytics-card grid, or wide management table.
**Don't** turn the shell into a retro terminal, control room, clinical triage surface, or provider-branded console.
**Don't** scatter shadows across ordinary rows or promote every bounded group into a card.
**Don't** use green as general decoration or collapse different evidence qualities into one healthy-looking state.
**Don't** imply that read-only or partially evidenced controls have live authority.
